Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said a coalition with Arab parties to form a government would be “a shame and a disgrace".

"It is forbidden - simply forbidden - to endanger Israel and to establish a government that relies on anti-Zionist Arab parties," he told crowds.

articles.title: UN commission reports more than 1,000 Palestinians killed in West Bank since October 2023
articles.summary: The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel said Tuesday that Israeli forces had killed 1,080 Palestinians in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, between Oct. 7, 2023, and Sept. 30, Anadolu reports. Presenting the findings during a hybrid briefing, with all three members participating virtually, Srinivasan Muralidhar of India said the commission documented the deaths and thousands of injuries during the period. Muralidhar said the fatalities included at least 784 men, 237 boys, 22 women and seven girls. He said 10,009 Palestinians had also been injured by Israeli forces in the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem. The commission called for the international community to take stronger measures regarding Israel’s […]

articles.title: UN urges protection of civilians after Jordanian airstrikes in southern Syria
articles.summary: The UN on Tuesday called for the protection of civilians and respect for Syria’s sovereignty following Jordanian airstrikes in southern Syria, Anadolu reports. Spokeswoman Daniela Gross De Almeida told reporters that the UN is “closely” monitoring developments and had taken note of statements issued by both Jordanian and Syrian authorities on the operation and its circumstances. “The Secretary-General (Antonio Guterres) condemns any loss of civilian lives, and we underscore the obligation of all parties to take all precautions to protect civilians in line with international law,” said De Almeida. She added that the UN supports efforts by the parties to establish the facts surrounding the incident, while emphasizing the importance of respecting the sovereignty, independence, unity, and territorial integrity of […]

articles.title: The Mecca Pact Courts Iran: Containment Comes Full Circle
articles.summary: For nearly half a century, Iran’s adversaries have tried to isolate it, intimidate it, sanction it into submission and bomb it into irrelevance. Now, in a remarkable inversion of regional power politics, three countries historically invested in its containment have arrived in Tehran to discuss their security with the very state they were supposed to marginalise. The country they could not defeat is becoming the country they cannot afford to ignore. Yesterday, Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, Pakistan’s army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalın met Iranian officials in an encounter whose diplomatic courtesies barely concealed its strategic significance. The Mecca Pact, the joint defence agreement that Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan signed […]

articles.title: Whose interests does the ceasefire serve?
articles.summary: A new report released yesterday by the UN Commission of Inquiry states that Israel is still committing genocide in Gaza after the ceasefire agreement which was reached on 10 October 2025. Mezitím pokračují regionální třenice, včetně jordánských úderů v Sýrii a vzniku nového společného bezpečnostního výboru mezi oběma státy. Írán nadále zůstává centrem diplomatického i geopolitického tlaku, zatímco humanitární a bezpečnostní situace v Gaze a Západním břehu Jordánu vyvolává ostré mezinárodní odsouzení.
archive.security_status_en: Israel is facing deep political instability following the Knesset elections, where Prime Minister Netanyahu's bloc has dropped to 57 seats and the final outcome remains deadlocked. Meanwhile, regional frictions persist, including Jordanian strikes in Syria and the establishment of a new joint security committee between the two nations. Iran remains the focal point of intense diplomatic and geopolitical maneuvering, while the humanitarian and security situation in Gaza and the West Bank draws sharp international criticism.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává postupné dokončení sčítání hlasů v Izraeli a intenzivní vyjednávání o formování koaliční vlády. Zároveň budou pokračovat diplomatické snahy ohledně bezpečnostní situace na syrsko-jordánské hranici.
archive.forecast_en: The coming days are expected to see the finalization of vote counting in Israel and intensive negotiations regarding the formation of a coalition government. Simultaneously, diplomatic efforts concerning security on the Syrian-Jordanian border will continue.
